annotations.title: Give one app its own link page order

description: Visitors from one app (source) see the bio page their own way: an order (links it leaves out follow in the page's order; a link that's off the page shows for this app only), links hidden from them, their featured card and their Shop the post order. Fields you leave out stay as they are; null clears one, and with all four clear the app sees the main page again. Pinned links keep their places and can't be hidden. Each change starts a new page version (tag), so the numbers keep the old and new orders apart. Undo puts the app's last setting back.

featured_link_id.description: The one link shown to them as a big card

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

order.description: link_ids in the order these visitors see them; the rest follow in the page's order

photo_order.description: post_ids for the order of Shop the post (shop_posts_list)

source.description: The app whose visitors this is for: its in-app browser, the ?s= tag on the page's address, or the site that sent them

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
